cases.given: a fresh installation with no account or network
cases.when: the user creates a family and logs an activity
expect: the activity is available locally
no relay family is registered

cases.given: a fresh installation with a valid invitation
cases.when: the person joins the invited Family
expect: the invited Family becomes available in the app
no empty local Family is created as a side effect

cases.given: one app with manager access to Family A and member access to Family B
cases.when: the person logs an activity in Family B, switches to Family A, and changes Family A membership
expect: the activity appears only in Family B's history and export
the membership change applies only to Family A
Family A and Family B use separate device keypairs
Family B's keys, role, and sync state are unchanged

cases.given: one app participates in shared Families A and B
cases.when: the device is removed from Family A
expect: Family A stops receiving new shared entries after its removal cutover
Family B remains writable and continues syncing
Family B's identity and encryption epoch are unchanged

cases.given: two Families independently represent the same real child
cases.when: both Families are joined in one app
expect: both child histories remain separately selectable
neither child identity nor history is merged automatically

cases.given: a local-only family with existing activities
expect: the existing activities become part of the encrypted shared history
the family remains usable offline

cases.given: a shared family with a manager and a member
cases.when: the member logs an activity and then tries to remove a device
expect: the activity is accepted for sync
the membership change is rejected

cases.given: a shared family with two managers
expect: the removal commits and a new key epoch begins
the remaining manager retains membership authority
the removed manager retains prior local data but gets no new epoch key

cases.given: a shared family with exactly one manager
cases.when: that manager tries to remove or demote themself without a successor
expect: the membership change is rejected
the family still has one manager

cases.given: a member with a complete local copy before removal
cases.when: a manager removes the member and the member starts a private copy
expect: the member retains data already on the device
the member receives no key for entries after the committed removal
the private copy has a new family identity and keys
new entries in the private copy do not sync to the old family
the private copy can be shared later as a separate family
